_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 Oct) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

recommendations.what: Move Seth's Epic gloves and boots to Howard, and Howard's Rare ones to Forrest
recommendations.why: Howard is the main tank in all four combat lineups but wears Rare gloves and boots. Seth is a gathering hero in no lineup, and his Epic gloves and boots beat Howard's on every stat. Howard's own Epic helmet (+20) and chest (+19) are better than Seth's, so keep those. Howard's freed Rare pieces (+20, +19) go to Forrest, the infantry hero in the Be march, instead of Seth; Seth takes Forrest's +12 pieces so no slot is left empty.

recommendations.what: Jabel reached Tier 4. Next promotions: Helga 5 shards, Saul 15, Chenko 25
recommendations.why: Jabel reached 3★ Tier 4 between the 22 and 25 Oct uploads (+27,600 power from the promotion; 2 / 40 to Tier 5 now). Howard (24 Oct) and Gordon (25 Oct) reached Tier 5, and Seth Tier 4 (24 Oct). The closest promotions now are Helga (5 to Tier 1), Saul (15 to Tier 1) and Chenko (25 to Tier 5). Helga and Saul are in no lineup; Chenko is in Arena offense and Barricade 2, so her shards matter most for combat. Next lineup heroes after her: Jabel 38 to Tier 5, Diana 46 to 4★ (54 / 100 on 23 Oct).

recommendations.what: Test a combat hero instead of Forrest in the Be (beast) march
recommendations.why: Forrest's two expedition skills only help wood (Woodland Inheritor: sawmill output; Master Woodcutter: wood gathering), so they do nothing in a beast fight. Diana (lead: -18% stamina, +60% hunting march speed) and Gordon (+15% squad Attack and Health) stay. Helga is the closest swap: she is also infantry, so the troop mix stays the same, and she adds Echoes of Valhalla (+10% squad Attack) and Oath of Guardian (16% chance to halve damage taken). Her hero power is lower (259,615 vs Forrest's 371,073), so test it before keeping it.

changes.note: Same classes (Archer, Cavalry, Infantry) and the same troop split

steps: Deploy → Be → remove Forrest → add Helga → Save.
Hit the same beast level you use now and compare troop losses with an earlier hunt.
evidence: hero.md expedition skills: Forrest (wood only), Helga (Echoes of Valhalla Lv. 2, Oath of Guardian Lv. 2), Gordon (Trash Talk, Super Nutrients), Diana (Iron Constitution Lv. 4, Quick Paced)
troops.md Be preset of 24 Oct: Diana (lead), Gordon, Forrest; 21,269 / 22,866 / 35,140
recommendations.note: Verified: the skill texts and the preset. Unverified: whether a hero's skills or raw power matter more against beasts, and whether all three heroes' expedition skills apply in a march. Other options if Helga does worse: Fahd (-12% enemy damage dealt; Cavalry like Gordon) or Saul (+6% DEF, +9% HP, +5% Lethality; Archer like Diana); whether two heroes of the same class can share a march is not recorded. Link to the priority-1 gear move: that move gives Howard's freed Rare gloves (+20) and boots (+19) to Forrest because he is in Be. If Helga replaces him, Forrest would use them only for gathering; Helga already wears Epic gear (Helm +10, Gloves +0, Shroud +3 on 22 Oct), so which of the two should get the Rare pieces is not worked out yet.

recommendations.what: Gathering: lead with the hero whose skill matches the resource
recommendations.why: Each gathering skill names one resource: Seth +20% iron, Edwin +15% stone, Forrest +15% wood, Olive +15% bread (wilderness gathering speed). The Gat preset (Seth lead, Edwin, Amane) only helps iron and stone, and Amane has no gathering skill (her expedition skills are Tri-Phalanx and Exorcism). With 4 march queues, one preset per resource would cover every tile type.

changes.note: Forrest is also in Be; a hero can be in only one march at a time (community rule, Unverified), so don't send both at once

steps: Deploy → Gat: keep it for iron (Seth leads).
Save presets 4 and 5 with Edwin (stone) and Olive (bread) as leads.
For wood, put Forrest in front when the Be march is home.
